K1, fixed (code CR17-1, CR17-2, CR17-4; controls C17-1, C17-2; security S17-2). tests/boundaries/ci-workflow.test.mjs no longer reads the workspace globs. It reads every git-tracked package.json, package.yaml and package.json5 through trackedManifests in the new scripts/install-surface.mjs, which runs git ls-files -z. Four tests guard that read: the read finds the root manifest and at least one below it; a fixture repository lists exactly the three manifest names; the read fails closed when git cannot list the tracked files; and a tracked manifest that does not parse as package.json is refused, which covers any package.yaml or package.json5. The root pins refuse pnpm:devPreinstall, preinstall, install, postinstall, preprepare, prepare and postprepare, so root preinstall and postinstall are now refused by name. Every manifest below the root is refused preinstall, install, postinstall, preprepare, prepare and postprepare.

K2, fixed (code CR17-3; controls C17-3; security S17-1; spec S17-1). topLevelKeys in scripts/install-surface.mjs reads the top-level keys of pnpm-workspace.yaml and pnpm-lock.yaml in four spellings: plain, double-quoted (escapes decoded), single-quoted and explicit '?'. It splits lines at CRLF, LF and a lone CR. A column-0 line it cannot read throws, and the read tests then go red. The read tests also require the keys packages and overrides, and lockfileVersion and importers. In pnpm-workspace.yaml the pins refuse pnpmfile and any other key containing pnpmfile (globalPnpmfile); in pnpm-lock.yaml they refuse pnpmfileChecksum. There is one test per key and spelling, twelve in all.

K3, fixed (security S17-4). pnpm-workspace.yaml may set none of allowBuilds, onlyBuiltDependencies, onlyBuiltDependenciesFile or dangerouslyAllowAllBuilds. No tracked manifest may name a file:, link:, relative, home or drive-letter path in dependencies, devDependencies, optionalDependencies or peerDependencies.

K4, the pnpmfile lesson, corrected (spec S17-2, controls I-1, security S17-3). The round-seventeen checkpoint says that a frozen install runs a .pnpmfile's top-level code and then fails on the pnpmfileChecksum mismatch. That holds only for a pnpmfile that exports hooks. pnpm 11.9.0 records a pnpmfileChecksum only for a pnpmfile that exports hooks. A hookless pnpmfile (module.exports = {}) records no checksum, its code runs, and the frozen install exits 0. The checksum pins therefore catch only a hook-bearing pnpmfile; the setting pins and the root-file test catch the rest. This supersedes the 'Lesson, not a control' entry of the round-seventeen checkpoint's declared_non_coverage and its ASSUMED line about where pnpm reads a pnpmfile (globalPnpmfile is a second setting). The round-seventeen checkpoint is not edited. The code comments that stated the old lesson were corrected in 45b5ca6.

topLevelKeys: no mutation covers a double-quoted key inside an explicit '?' key. A single-quoted key's doubled quote is left as written, because no refused key contains a quote. A column-0 line it cannot read (an anchor, a tag, a merge key, a flow mapping, a document marker or a directive) is refused, not read, so it can refuse valid YAML. The pnpm-file and PNPMFILE keys are refused as other pnpmfile keys although pnpm 11.9.0 ignored them.

Not pinned: configDependencies in pnpm-workspace.yaml, which may carry a pnpmfile in a config dependency (not probed), and a local path in package.json resolutions or pnpm.overrides. pnpm-workspace.yaml overrides are already pinned to exact versions.

Lesson, superseding the round-seventeen entry: pnpm records a pnpmfileChecksum only for a pnpmfile that exports hooks. A hookless pnpmfile runs on a frozen install that exits 0, so the checksum pins are not a second line of defence. CI's --ignore-pnpmfile (PR 16, 9e5ac41) is what stops a pnpmfile from running in CI. The setting pins and the root-file test keep a pnpmfile from being configured at all, including for a developer's local pnpm.
The PROBE, GAP and RED rows were observed on Windows 11 under Git Bash, where pnpm runs scripts through cmd.exe. CI on ubuntu-latest is the Linux observation of the pins, not of the probes.
